text: I'm the homeless boyfriend. I'm the poor boyfriend. I'm the middle class boyfriend. And I'm the rich boyfriend. Who got their girlfriend the better gift? Well, I didn't get my girl anything for Christmas. Well, that guy sucks. At least I got my girl a brand new water bottle. Not like she already has 20 of these. And I got my girl a five pack of fruit containers for the fridge. Well, I was on a tight budget, so I had to get creative. I actually got my girl a digital picture frame where she can upload any photos from her phone. She can also give her friends, me, or family members access and anyone can upload any photos they want to be displayed on here. It can show horizontally or vertically.
